dialogues.en: "I should put a TV in this room."
dialogues.text: "I should put a TV in this room."

dialogues.en: "Or I could play CDs really loud."
dialogues.text: "Or I could play CDs really loud."

dialogues.en: "......But my neighbor would probably complain..."
dialogues.text: "......But my neighbor would probably complain..."

dialogues.jp: 「ＺＺＺ……」

dialogues.en: "......I should get changed."
dialogues.text: "......I should get changed."

dialogues.jp:
春の穏やかな空気をかき乱す、無粋な騒音が聞
こえてくる。
dialogues.en: I change into my school uniform.
dialogues.text: I change into my school uniform.

dialogues.jp: ったく、今はゴールデンウイーク真っ直中──
dialogues.en:
I like it when I don't have to change so fast, as opposed to
winter times.
dialogues.text:
I like it when I don't have to change so fast, as opposed to
winter times.

dialogues.jp: は、もう終わりか。
dialogues.en:
But there's one negative side to it, because I can be so
slow to get changed that I'm late for school.
dialogues.text:
But there's one negative side to it, because I can be so
slow to get changed that I'm late for school.

dialogues.en: "Breakfast......"
dialogues.text: "Breakfast......"

dialogues.jp: 「あ〜……かったる」
dialogues.en: I murmur, and take a big bite of the toast.
dialogues.text: I murmur, and take a big bite of the toast.

dialogues.jp: 目覚まし時計にチョップを落とす。
dialogues.en:
The bread I bought about a week ago doesn't taste so good at
all. I feel like I'm eating paper, so I swallow it with a
sip of coffee.
dialogues.text:
The bread I bought about a week ago doesn't taste so good at
all. I feel like I'm eating paper, so I swallow it with a
sip of coffee.

dialogues.jp:
途端に、かしましかった部屋の中が、しんと静
かになってしまう。
dialogues.en: "......I should go buy a coffee machine."
dialogues.text: "......I should go buy a coffee machine."

dialogues.en: "I'm leaving..."
dialogues.text: "I'm leaving..."

dialogues.jp: 「今度、部屋の中にテレビでも置こうかな」
dialogues.en:
I go outside and inhale a full breath of air and sunshine to
my lungs.
dialogues.text:
I go outside and inhale a full breath of air and sunshine to
my lungs.

dialogues.jp: 「あるいは、ＣＤをガンガンにかけてみるとか」
dialogues.en:
I feel like some kind of vital energy is filled up in my
body. I feel a little excited.
dialogues.text:
I feel like some kind of vital energy is filled up in my
body. I feel a little excited.

dialogues.jp: 「……苦情が来るか」
dialogues.en: A scent of flowers.
dialogues.text: A scent of flowers.

dialogues.en: A shadow of a flying butterfly.
dialogues.text: A shadow of a flying butterfly.

dialogues.jp: 「……着替えよ」
dialogues.en: It is so 'spring'.
dialogues.text: It is so 'spring'.

dialogues.jp: もたくさと、学生服を身にまとっていく。
dialogues.en:
It's the season where you don't fit in if you don't have a
smile on your face.
dialogues.text:
It's the season where you don't fit in if you don't have a
smile on your face.

dialogues.jp:
冬と違って、超スピードを発揮する必要がない
のが楽である。
dialogues.en: I send an order to the muscles on my face to smile.
dialogues.text: I send an order to the muscles on my face to smile.

dialogues.jp:
あまりのんびりして、学園に遅れるという難点
があるのも事実だが……。
dialogues.en:
The never-dying cherry tree's dead now, but it's still
spring. The other cherry trees are starting to sprout.
dialogues.text:
The never-dying cherry tree's dead now, but it's still
spring. The other cherry trees are starting to sprout.

dialogues.jp: 「いただきます……」
dialogues.en:
People are trying to find out the reason why the cherry tree
died, but I think they should have tried to find out why it
had never died.
dialogues.text:
People are trying to find out the reason why the cherry tree
died, but I think they should have tried to find out why it
had never died.

dialogues.jp: 何となく呟き、トーストにかじりつく。
dialogues.en: Time doesn't stop.
dialogues.text: Time doesn't stop.

dialogues.jp:
買い置きのパンはあまり美味しくない。紙を噛
んでいるような気がして、俺はコーヒーを流し
込んだ。
dialogues.en: When something begins, it ends someday.
dialogues.text: When something begins, it ends someday.

dialogues.jp: 「……今度、コーヒーメーカーでも買おうかな」
dialogues.en:
Even though the cherry tree which we all thought would be
there forever did eventually die...
dialogues.text:
Even though the cherry tree which we all thought would be
there forever did eventually die...

dialogues.jp: 「行ってきま〜す、と」
dialogues.en: I know and everybody knows...
dialogues.text: I know and everybody knows...

dialogues.jp:
外に出たところで、肺いっぱいに空気と陽光を
吸い込む。
dialogues.en: That spring will always comes back......
dialogues.text: That spring will always comes back......

dialogues.jp:
何か、生命の活力みたいなものが、身体の中に
充満するような気がして少しだけ高揚を覚える。
dialogues.en: "Good morning!"
dialogues.text: "Good morning!"

dialogues.jp: 花の香り。
dialogues.en: And there's one guy who'll probably never change.
dialogues.text: And there's one guy who'll probably never change.

dialogues.jp: 舞い飛ぶ蝶の影。
dialogues.en:
"Why are you looking like a patient suffering from a gastric
ulcer who is forcing himself to smile but then ending up
just making his face smaller with wrinkles?"
dialogues.text:
"Why are you looking like a patient suffering from a gastric
ulcer who is forcing himself to smile but then ending up
just making his face smaller with wrinkles?"

dialogues.jp: 何というか、春。
dialogues.en: "This is an exemplary smile."
dialogues.text: "This is an exemplary smile."

dialogues.jp:
笑顔以外は似つかわしくないような、そんな
……季節。
dialogues.en:
"Hmm. I recommend you read a dictionary carefully or look at
a mirror carefully."
dialogues.text:
"Hmm. I recommend you read a dictionary carefully or look at
a mirror carefully."

dialogues.jp: ピピピと、俺は、顔面の筋肉に指令を送った。

枯れずの桜は枯れてしまったが、今は春。結局
のところ、桜は芽吹いている。
dialogues.en: I keep walking.
dialogues.text: I keep walking.

dialogues.jp:
島では、枯れてしまった原因を究明しようとし
ているらしいが、そもそも、枯れないことの方
が不思議だったと思うのだが……。
dialogues.en: "Why are you here?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you here?"

dialogues.jp: 時間は立ち止まれない。
dialogues.en: "I wanted to tell you the good news as soon as possible."
dialogues.text: "I wanted to tell you the good news as soon as possible."

dialogues.jp: 始まった以上は、いつかは終わるのだ。
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
ずっとそこにあり続けると思っていた桜も、今
は枯れてしまったけれど……。
dialogues.en: I look at Suginami's face for the first time today.
dialogues.text: I look at Suginami's face for the first time today.

dialogues.jp: 俺も、誰も、知っている。
dialogues.en:
He has as big a smile as he can. I wonder if he was abducted
by aliens during the holidays.
dialogues.text:
He has as big a smile as he can. I wonder if he was abducted
by aliens during the holidays.

dialogues.jp: 過ぎ去った春は、また巡って来る事を……。
dialogues.en: "What's your good news?"
dialogues.text: "What's your good news?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おはようっ、いい朝だなっ」
dialogues.en:
"I finally found out why our friends, Mako Mizukoshi and her
sister, had been looking down."
dialogues.text:
"I finally found out why our friends, Mako Mizukoshi and her
sister, had been looking down."

dialogues.jp:
そして、いつまでも変わらないと思われる男が、
ここに１名。

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「って何だその、胃かいよう患者が、無理矢理
　くしゃおじさんの真似事をしているような顔
　は？」
dialogues.en:
I remember Mako seemed to look down last time I saw her. I
totally forgot about it because I was too busy taking care
of my own problem.
dialogues.text:
I remember Mako seemed to look down last time I saw her. I
totally forgot about it because I was too busy taking care
of my own problem.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「｛はじ／弾｝ける笑顔だ」
dialogues.en: "Moe-sempai was down as well for the same reason?"
dialogues.text: "Moe-sempai was down as well for the same reason?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ほお。お前には、辞書の精読をお勧めしてお
　こうか。あるいは、鏡の凝視」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en:
"There's an old friend of theirs called Misaki Sagisawa,
and......"
dialogues.text:
"There's an old friend of theirs called Misaki Sagisawa,
and......"

dialogues.jp: 立ち止まらずに、そのまま歩く。
dialogues.en: "Wait a minute."
dialogues.text: "Wait a minute."

dialogues.jp: 「何で、この道に居るんだよ？」
dialogues.en: I stop. Suginami takes one step forward and turns around.
dialogues.text: I stop. Suginami takes one step forward and turns around.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「おう。一刻も早く、おまえに調査結果を教え
　たいと思ってな」
dialogues.en: "I know. The last name is the same as hers, huh?"
dialogues.text: "I know. The last name is the same as hers, huh?"

dialogues.jp: 初めて杉並にまともに目を向ける。
dialogues.en: He smiles like he knows everything.
dialogues.text: He smiles like he knows everything.

dialogues.jp:
ニカニカと笑う杉並に、休み中、ステージでも
上がったか？　などと思ってしまう。
dialogues.en:
But it's not only her last name. It's the name of the owner
of 'Yoriko the cat'.
dialogues.text:
But it's not only her last name. It's the name of the owner
of 'Yoriko the cat'.

dialogues.jp: 「あんだ？　調査結果って」

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「我が非公式新聞部独自の取材で、水越姉妹の
　悩みのタネが判明したのだ」
dialogues.en: "I haven't seen Sagisawa-san lately. How's she doing?"
dialogues.text: "I haven't seen Sagisawa-san lately. How's she doing?"

dialogues.jp:
まだ、そんなことをやっていたのか……。それ
にしても独自取材っていったい何をしたんだ？
dialogues.en:
"Ah...... she's... fine. So? What else do you know about
that girl?"
dialogues.text:
"Ah...... she's... fine. So? What else do you know about
that girl?"

dialogues.jp:
「ん？　てか、萌先輩も｛ふさ／塞｝いでいたのか？　同
　じ理由で？」
dialogues.en: I start to walk again to get back in the flow of students.
dialogues.text: I start to walk again to get back in the flow of students.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そうだ」
dialogues.en:
"Misaki has been in a coma for unknown reasons since early
April."
dialogues.text:
"Misaki has been in a coma for unknown reasons since early
April."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「実は、二人の共通の幼なじみに、｛さぎさわ／鷺澤｝｛みさき／美咲｝と
　いう人物が居てな……」
dialogues.en: "She's in...... a coma?"
dialogues.text: "She's in...... a coma?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと待て」
dialogues.en: "Do you know her? Do you know Misaki Sagisawa?"
dialogues.text: "Do you know her? Do you know Misaki Sagisawa?"

dialogues.jp:
ぴたっと足を止める。１歩半先に行ってから、
杉並は振り返った。
dialogues.en: "No. Not really...... And?"
dialogues.text: "No. Not really...... And?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「分かってる。名字が同じだと言いたいんだろ」
dialogues.en: "You sounded like you know her... Anyway..."
dialogues.text: "You sounded like you know her... Anyway..."

dialogues.jp: 訳知り顔でニカっと笑う。
dialogues.en: He gets suspicious for a moment, but continues talking.
dialogues.text: He gets suspicious for a moment, but continues talking.

dialogues.jp:
それだけじゃない。それは“猫頼子”の飼い主
の名前だ。
dialogues.en:
"She's been in a hospital on this island for a while, but
recently she just come out of the coma."
dialogues.text:
"She's been in a hospital on this island for a while, but
recently she just come out of the coma."

dialogues.en: "How?"
dialogues.text: "How?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「あ？　そういや、最近、サギーを見ないな。
　どうかしたのか？」
dialogues.en:
"It seems like it also just happened without any known
cause."
dialogues.text:
"It seems like it also just happened without any known
cause."

dialogues.jp: 止めていた足を、再び、通学の急流に乗せる。

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ふむ。その美咲さんがな。４月の頭頃に、原
　因不明の意識不明な状態に陥ったのだ」
dialogues.en: "So that made the Mizukoshi sisters smile again."
dialogues.text: "So that made the Mizukoshi sisters smile again."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「意識不明……彼女が？」
dialogues.en:
"This is good! Friends of my friends are my friends, you
know!"
dialogues.text:
"This is good! Friends of my friends are my friends, you
know!"

dialogues.jp: 一瞬、｛いぶか／訝｝しげにしたが、杉並は話を続けた。
dialogues.en:
He gives me strong pats on my shoulder like he's proud of
himself.
dialogues.text:
He gives me strong pats on my shoulder like he's proud of
himself.

dialogues.jp: 杉並が残念そうに呟く。
……無茶言うなよ。
dialogues.en:
When I look around, the students who were just walking
around us have disappeared.
dialogues.text:
When I look around, the students who were just walking
around us have disappeared.

dialogues.jp:
「ま、いいじゃないか。少なくともこれで、眞
　子にシカトされることはなくなったんだから」
dialogues.en: "Are we going to be late for school?"
dialogues.text: "Are we going to be late for school?"

dialogues.jp: 人類みな兄弟方式に、ばんばんと肩を叩く。
dialogues.en: He's such an idiot. But I couldn't stop smiling.
dialogues.text: He's such an idiot. But I couldn't stop smiling.

dialogues.en: "Hey you, idiot! We have to run!"
dialogues.text: "Hey you, idiot! We have to run!"

dialogues.jp:
ふと気が付くと、周りを歩いていたはずの学生
の姿が全くない。
dialogues.en: "Is our teacher already here......?"
dialogues.text: "Is our teacher already here......?"

dialogues.jp: 「もしや、俺ら、遅刻してるのか？」
dialogues.en:
There are no students walking in the corridor, and all the
doors are closed. It looks like we're late.
dialogues.text:
There are no students walking in the corridor, and all the
doors are closed. It looks like we're late.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ん？　おお、そういや、道の真ん真ん中で、
　ずいぶんと突っ立っていたような気が」
dialogues.en:
"You should feel sorry for me because I was there waiting
for you for 30 minutes and you made me be late for school."
dialogues.text:
"You should feel sorry for me because I was there waiting
for you for 30 minutes and you made me be late for school."

dialogues.jp:
朝の攻防というやつ。廊下には学生の姿はなく、
教室のドアも閉まっていて、負けを予感する。
dialogues.en: "All right, all right."
dialogues.text: "All right, all right."

dialogues.jp: 老人的な返答で受け流し、教室の前へ。
dialogues.en:
I'm half listening to him as I reach the door of my
classroom.
dialogues.text:
I'm half listening to him as I reach the door of my
classroom.

dialogues.jp:
「……静かだな。もう、ＨＲが始まっているの
　か……？」
dialogues.en:
"......It's so quiet. I think the teacher's already taking
attendance."
dialogues.text:
"......It's so quiet. I think the teacher's already taking
attendance."

dialogues.jp: ため息をひとつして、教室のドアに手を掛ける。
dialogues.en: I give a sigh and slowly open the door.
dialogues.text: I give a sigh and slowly open the door.

dialogues.jp:
「｛さぎさわ／鷺澤｝｛みさき／美咲｝と申します。よろしくお願いします
　……」
dialogues.en: "My name is Misaki Sagisawa. It's very nice to meet you..."
dialogues.text: "My name is Misaki Sagisawa. It's very nice to meet you..."

dialogues.jp: 少女が、ぺこりと頭を下げる。
dialogues.en: The girl bows.
dialogues.text: The girl bows.

dialogues.jp: 背後で、杉並が何かを呟くのが聞こえる。
dialogues.en: I can hear Suginami saying something to me behind me.
dialogues.text: I can hear Suginami saying something to me behind me.

dialogues.jp:
クラスの何割かの正面顔が、視界の縁にぼうっ
と浮かび上がる。
dialogues.en:
I see some blurry faces of my classmates at the corners of
my eyes.
dialogues.text:
I see some blurry faces of my classmates at the corners of
my eyes.

dialogues.jp:
教壇に立つ少女が、目の中に真っ直ぐに飛び込
んできた。
dialogues.en:
And the girl who's standing in front of everybody jumps into
the center of my sight.
dialogues.text:
And the girl who's standing in front of everybody jumps into
the center of my sight.

dialogues.jp:
時間、あるいは身体の機能。その、どちらかが
停止していた。
dialogues.en: Either time or my bodily functions just stopped.
dialogues.text: Either time or my bodily functions just stopped.

dialogues.jp: （頼子……さん？）
dialogues.en: (Yoriko......san?)
dialogues.text: (Yoriko......san?)

dialogues.jp: 違う。違う。
dialogues.en: No, she's not.
dialogues.text: No, she's not.

dialogues.jp: 望みは湧き上がった反論に、瞬時に圧倒された。
dialogues.en: My wish is quickly crushed by my counterargument.
dialogues.text: My wish is quickly crushed by my counterargument.

dialogues.jp: 鷺澤美咲。
dialogues.en: Misaki Sagisawa.
dialogues.text: Misaki Sagisawa.

dialogues.jp: それが、彼女の名前……。
dialogues.en: That's her name......
dialogues.text: That's her name......

dialogues.speaker: Schoolgirl
dialogues.jp: 「ねえねえ、朝倉くんどうしたんだろね……？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, look...... What's wrong with Asakura-kun......?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, look...... What's wrong with Asakura-kun......?"

dialogues.jp:
暦先生が俺の名前を呼ぶ声に、ハッと我に返っ
た。
dialogues.en:
Our teacher, Koyomi-sensei, calls my name and I blink myself
out of my trance.
dialogues.text:
Our teacher, Koyomi-sensei, calls my name and I blink myself
out of my trance.

dialogues.jp: 教室のざわめきが、うわっと鼓膜に迫ってくる。
dialogues.en: The noise of the students suddenly hits my eardrums.
dialogues.text: The noise of the students suddenly hits my eardrums.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「どした、朝倉？　さっさと席につけ。それか
　ら、杉並もな」
dialogues.en:
"Asakura, what are you doing standing there? Take your seat
quickly. Suginami, you too."
dialogues.text:
"Asakura, what are you doing standing there? Take your seat
quickly. Suginami, you too."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「あいあい」
dialogues.en: "Yes, at once."
dialogues.text: "Yes, at once."

dialogues.jp:
動けない俺の背中を押して、杉並が教室の中に
滑り込んだ。
dialogues.en: Suginami pushes my back and steps inside the classroom.
dialogues.text: Suginami pushes my back and steps inside the classroom.

dialogues.jp:
身体中に｛さび／錆｝が発生したようにぎくしゃくと、俺
は自分の席を目指した。
dialogues.en:
I wobble to my seat as if my entire body was completely
rusted out.
dialogues.text:
I wobble to my seat as if my entire body was completely
rusted out.

dialogues.jp: ◆鷺澤美咲◆

誰もいない家に、「いってきます」と言って、
学園へ向かう。

桜並木……あの桜はもう枯れてしまっている。
そして、あの人はもう戻ってこない。全ては過
ぎ去った過去の出来事なんだ。

そんな想いに耽っていると、変わることの無い
男、杉並に会った。調査結果の報告だとかぬか
している。
dialogues.en: "Zzz, zzz......"
dialogues.text: "Zzz, zzz......"

dialogues.jp:
すっかり忘れていたが、眞子の、というより姉
妹が最近落ち込んでいた理由が判明したのだそ
うだ。二人して同じ原因で｛ふさ／塞｝いでいたらしい。

そんなこと、すっかり忘れていたが、杉並は構
わずに報告を続けていた。「二人の幼馴染の鷺
澤美咲が……」という言葉に俺は反応した。
dialogues.en:
From outside the window, I hear the noise that ruins the
gentle spring air.
dialogues.text:
From outside the window, I hear the noise that ruins the
gentle spring air.

dialogues.jp:
杉並は訝しみながら、話を続けた。どうやら彼
女が長らく意識不明の状態に陥っていて、そし
て先日回復したのだという。
dialogues.en:
Why's everybody so noisy in the middle of the biggest
holidays in Japan......
dialogues.text:
Why's everybody so noisy in the middle of the biggest
holidays in Japan......

dialogues.jp:
原因は不明、だそうだ。鷺澤美咲……それは、
猫の頼子の飼い主の名前。
dialogues.en: Oh, the holidays are over...
dialogues.text: Oh, the holidays are over...

dialogues.jp:
教室につく頃には、思い切り遅れてしまってい
た。杉並と話こみすぎたか。
だが、ドアを開けて、俺は驚いた。
dialogues.en: "Ugh...... What a pain..."
dialogues.text: "Ugh...... What a pain..."

dialogues.jp:
そこでは転校生の頼子さんが……いや、鷺澤美
咲が自己紹介をしているところだった。
dialogues.en: I gave the alarm clock a karate-chop.
dialogues.text: I gave the alarm clock a karate-chop.

dialogues.jp:
過ぎ去った過去は戻ってこないが、春はまた来
るものなんだ――でも、それは新しい春に違い
は無い。
dialogues.en: All of a sudden, the noisy room gets so quiet.
dialogues.text: All of a sudden, the noisy room gets so quiet.

dialogues.jp: 俺はそう、自分の中で結論づけていた。
